claims.behavior: The shortcut command editor offers the reference's content commands: flip on/off or set a tag on a local tag service, and flip, set, increment or decrement a like, numerical or inc/dec rating, worded in set lists as the reference words them. The media viewer runs them on the shown file from the media and media_viewer sets, and from custom sets turned on with the top hover's keyboard button (set current/default shortcuts, kept as default_media_viewer_custom_shortcuts).
limits: Only the simple commands with native executors and the content commands can be chosen; the reference's full simple-command catalogue is absent.
Tags and ratings are typed rather than picked with autocomplete and rating controls; repository tag services are not offered; thumbnails do not run content commands.
The keyboard button's 'edit shortcuts' opens the whole options dialog.
